tasks.DefineProblem: Understand the problem of finding the longest common subsequence for two given sequences.
tasks.DesignAlgorithm: Design an algorithm to solve the defined problem with consideration for time and space complexity optimizations.
tasks.ImplementCode: Write a function in Python that implements the designed algorithm, ensuring it handles edge cases such as no common subsequences.
tasks.TestFunction: Verify the correctness of the implemented function using provided test cases.
